newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end Tokyo up as investors flock to 10-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end Tokyo up as investors flock to 10-yr bond.

text.p: *Key March 10-year JGBs ended higher on dealers' short-covering as newly auctioned 10-year JGBs saw better-than-expected sales. *Some dealers said foreigners were also buying March contract ahead of shift in benchmark status later this week.
